title: 🎂 Something Is Wrong in Port Halloway… | The Last Birthday (1983)
author: Due-Nature9853
selftext:
​

Hey everyone! 👋 I'm an indie game developer, and I wanted to share a video from my horror game, The Last Birthday (1983).

Set in the mysterious town of Port Halloway, Maryland, this horror experience takes you into a disturbing world filled with secrets, unsettling mysteries, and a past that refuses to stay buried.

🎮 Play the game here:

https://christine-890.itch.io/the-last-birthday-1983

🎵 Music credit:

“Steampianist metal sonic thing” by Jonathan Joestar

Listen on SoundCloud: https://on.soundcloud.com/XCMfrDbKBxXJjTDVrU

I'm continuing to develop and improve this project, and I'd love to hear your thoughts!

If you enjoy indie horror games, atmospheric horror, and mysterious stories, give it a look. 🕯️

What do you think of the atmosphere and the direction of the game? I'd appreciate any feedback!

\#IndieHorror #HorrorGames #IndieGameDev
